title: Om Nom and Dark Park
statementMd:
Om Nom is the main character of a game "Cut the Rope". He is a bright little monster who likes visiting friends living at the other side of the park. However the dark old parks can scare even somebody as fearless as Om Nom, so he asks you to help him.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/26fa9ef1e99302468e420da92b75b4bb12f64a2c.png)

The park consists of $2^{*n* + 1} - 1$ squares connected by roads so that the scheme of the park is a full binary tree of depth $*n*$. More formally, the entrance to the park is located at the square $1$. The exits out of the park are located at squares $2^{*n*}, 2^{*n*} + 1, ..., 2^{*n* + 1} - 1$ and these exits lead straight to the Om Nom friends' houses. From each square $*i*$ ($2 ≤ *i* < 2^{*n* + 1}$) there is a road to the square ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1040a5e20739aa4ff1bdd6fb60e6665f025a3f1e.png). Thus, it is possible to go from the park entrance to each of the exits by walking along exactly $*n*$ roads.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/937f6c9f63488cb7a5785abd858898042c473421.png)

To light the path roads in the evening, the park keeper installed street lights along each road. The road that leads from square

*i*

to square

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1d68be37100780bc5f918255b6da4287c591da33.png)

has

*a*<sub>*i*</sub>

lights.

Om Nom loves counting lights on the way to his friend. Om Nom is afraid of spiders who live in the park, so he doesn't like to walk along roads that are not enough lit. What he wants is that the way to any of his friends should have in total the same number of lights. That will make him feel safe.

He asked you to help him install additional lights. Determine what minimum number of lights it is needed to additionally place on the park roads so that a path from the entrance to any exit of the park contains the same number of street lights. You may add an arbitrary number of street lights to each of the roads.

## Input

The first line contains integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10$) — the number of roads on the path from the entrance to any exit.

The next line contains $2^{*n* + 1} - 2$ numbers $*a*_{2}, *a*_{3}, ... *a*_{2^{*n* + 1} - 1}$ — the initial numbers of street lights on each road of the park. Here $*a*_{*i*}$ is the number of street lights on the road between squares $*i*$ and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1d68be37100780bc5f918255b6da4287c591da33.png). All numbers $*a*_{*i*}$ are positive integers, not exceeding $100$.

## Output

Print the minimum number of street lights that we should add to the roads of the park to make Om Nom feel safe.

## Note

Picture for the sample test. Green color denotes the additional street lights.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8bf2560e1f9c312298f87b0c551e74d976fd4ff5.png)
statementZhMd:
Om Nom 是游戏 "Cut the Rope" 的主角。他是一只聪明的小怪物，喜欢去拜访住在公园另一边的朋友。然而，昏暗的老公园甚至会吓到像 Om Nom 这样无所畏惧的家伙，因此他请求你帮助他。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/26fa9ef1e99302468e420da92b75b4bb12f64a2c.png)

公园由 $2^{*n* + 1} - 1$ 个广场组成，这些广场通过道路连接，整个公园的结构是一棵深度为 $*n*$ 的满二叉树。更正式地说，公园入口位于广场 $1$。公园出口位于广场 $2^{*n*}, 2^{*n*} + 1, ..., 2^{*n* + 1} - 1$，这些出口可以直接通往 Om Nom 朋友们的家。从每个广场 $*i*$（$2 ≤ *i* < 2^{*n* + 1}$）都有一条道路通往广场 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1040a5e20739aa4ff1bdd6fb60e6665f025a3f1e.png)。因此，从公园入口到每个出口都恰好需要沿着 $*n*$ 条道路行走。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/937f6c9f63488cb7a5785abd858898042c473421.png)

为了在夜晚照亮道路，公园管理员在每条道路上都安装了路灯。从广场

*i*

通往广场

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1d68be37100780bc5f918255b6da4287c591da33.png)

的道路上有

*a*<sub>*i*</sub>

盏路灯。

Om Nom 喜欢数前往朋友家路上的路灯。Om Nom 害怕生活在公园里的蜘蛛，因此他不喜欢走在照明不足的道路上。他希望前往任何一位朋友家的道路上，路灯总数都相同。这样会让他感到安全。

他请求你帮助他安装额外的路灯。请确定至少需要在公园道路上额外安装多少盏路灯，才能使从入口到公园任意出口的路径上都包含相同数量的路灯。你可以在每条道路上任意增加数量的路灯。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10$），表示从入口到任意出口的路径上道路的数量。

下一行包含 $2^{*n* + 1} - 2$ 个整数 $*a*_{2}, *a*_{3}, ... *a*_{2^{*n* + 1} - 1}$，表示公园中每条道路上初始的路灯数量。其中，$*a*_{*i*}$ 表示连接广场 $*i*$ 和 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1d68be37100780bc5f918255b6da4287c591da33.png) 的道路上的路灯数量。所有 $*a*_{*i*}$ 都是正整数，且不超过 $100$。

## 输出格式

输出为了让 Om Nom 感到安全，至少需要在公园道路上增加的路灯数量。
